No fresh session read and judged a claim that had existed for a third of a second. session() returns whatever TRUTH_SESSION says, so the gate compares two strings the same process can choose. The system's most load-bearing property -- that live means independently verified -- is currently an attestation, inside a ledger built on the premise that unevidenced assertions rot. WHAT WILL NOT WORK, and why, so nobody rebuilds it: cryptographic signing is void here because one operator on one machine holds every key, and this repo already red-teamed and falsified a linear hash chain for this regime; a refusal keyed on latency is worse than nothing because it is defeated by a sleep and it TEACHES that bypass, which is the confused-deputy shape ADR-011 exists to prevent. IMPLEMENT, in the honest order: (1) surface what the existing records already prove, with NO schema change -- author-to-first-verdict latency and whether a session both authored claims and filed verdicts on those same claims are both derivable from the ledger today, retroactively; (2) report them in truth stats and warn in doctor, ADVISORY only, never a refusal; (3) correct the documentation so live is described as what it is -- the paper's honest-limitations section is the right home, and the ADR-021 lesson applies: name the boundary you actually enforce rather than the one you wish you had. THEN the decision that is the operator's, not this item's: either separation becomes genuinely evidenced (harness-supplied session provenance the CLI cannot forge -- both Claude Code and pi know their own identity, but an agent can write any file inside the repo, so this needs a channel outside it), or it is DISCLOSED as a process property the machinery does not enforce. Both are defensible; pretending is not. VALIDATE: replay against history -- the surface must flag the 33 sub-sixty-second first-agrees and the 0.282s case, and must NOT flag this session's genuinely independent verifications, where fresh agents each ran dispatch, read files, and took minutes. Derive any threshold from the measured distribution rather than guessing it: a guessed threshold in ADR-039 would have refused 82 of 96 real filings, and that replay is why the gate did not ship. Report the false-positive rate before choosing. DONE WHEN: the ledger can show, from its own records, which verifications carry evidence of separation and which carry only a name -- and the docs no longer claim more than that.
